title: PANGE LINGUA GLORIOSI.
html_source:
From the Latin:
Speak with the tongue of the glorious one.

anchor.prefix:
art.

 —Who knows? said Stephen, smiling. Perhaps Aquinas would understand me better than you. He was a poet himself. He wrote a hymn for Maundy Thursday. It begins with the words
anchor.suffix: They say it is the highest glory of the hymnal. It is an intricate and soothing hymn. I like it; but there is no hymn that can be put beside that mournful and majestic processiona
